train_feedforward_model: train a FeedForward neural network with optional per-layer gradient scaling using LayerwiseGradientScaler
train_convnet_model: train a SimpleConvNet vision model on CIFAR10 with per-layer gradient scaling via LayerwiseGradientScaler
test_linear_model: test that a FeedForward model trained with and without per-layer scaling produces identical gradients
test_vision_model: test that a SimpleConvNet trained with and without per-layer scaling produces identical gradients on CIFAR10
get_params_with_grad: get all parameter gradients from a trained PyTorch model by iterating over named modules and parameters
